headline: Hello Sunshine Cuts 50% of Workforce Following Management Buyback
summary: Reese Witherspoon repurchased control of production company Hello Sunshine alongside Mediawan, following which the firm laid off 50 percent of its staff to prioritize films, series, and its book club.
why: Hello Sunshine is a prominent Hollywood production firm, and the retrenchment reflects ongoing restructuring and margin pressures across the film and television sector.

impacts.name: Hello Sunshine
impacts.why: The studio is sharply cutting staff to streamline costs under renewed ownership.
